courses.title: Agricultural Marketing
courses.description: Economic analysis of food marketing firms and institutions; identification and measurement of dimensions of market performance; public policy.

courses.title: Rural Development Research Methods and Topics
courses.description: Advanced theories and methods for rural economic development research.

courses.title: Internship
courses.description: Supervised off-campus, nongroup instruction, including field experiences, practicums, or internships. Written and oral critique of activity required.

courses.title: Individual Studies
courses.description: Creative projects, including nonthesis research, which are supervised on an individual basis and fall outside the scope of formal courses.

courses.title: Special Topics
courses.description: Formal courses given infrequently to explore, in depth, a comparatively narrow subject which may be topical or of specific interest.
